caveats: Not a backtest or proof of maker fill probability/profitability.
Books are sequential REST snapshots, not atomic cross-outcome state.
Top-level depth is aggregate displayed size, not known queue priority.
Public taker trade rows are bounded to latest 1000 within 24h; truncated windows are lower bounds, not full volume.
No private account fields or public trader identities are stored.
Gross paired spread requires both outcomes to fill in equal quantities and later capital release; a single fill creates directional inventory.
